[message_id=687117 author=JK-Piece first=True]
The following is written for the Open Progress Prize:
Open Progress Prize: $5,000 + 1 DGX Sparks 
Awarded to the team with the highest leaderboard score as of the Midpoint Cut-off Date: April 9, 2026.
Methodology submissions Cut-off Date: April 16, 2026.
Winners will be announced during Cloud NEXT (April 22-24, 2026)
Each eligible participant may receive no more than one (1) DGX Spark.
Because many participants may want to form teams to compete for this prize, **will each member of a team receive 1 DGX Sparks? **
The question is crucial because 1 DGX Spark cannot be shared among different members of a team.

[message_id=3433990 author=Addison Howard first=False]
Hi there-
Only 1 DGX Spark is available for the Open Progress prize. If you are on a team with multiple members, you can choose how to divide the prize (cash and DGX spark) accordingly.

[message_id=3434225 author=Donald Galliano III first=False]
Hi. I made a post a few days ago about this. Is the prize awarded based on the private or public leaderboard?

[message_id=3434233 author=JK-Piece first=False]
Based on the public leaderboard for sure

[message_id=3434255 author=Donald Galliano III first=False]
Awesome! Thanks. That lets us know the winners basically end of April 9th then for the midpoint.

[message_id=3433936 author=lakshmig82 first=False]
And also re scoring must be done as soon as possible to refine solutions. Otherwise we are optimizing blindly for the next 2 weeks.
